subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu image-card composition happen automatically for text/presentation plus image attachments, or require a Feishu-scoped opt-in trigger?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but the default send shape and fallback/safety policy affect existing Feishu users and need plugin-owner intent before automation should implement or merge the behavior.

options.title: Opt-in image cards
options.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing sequential text-plus-media sends keep their current behavior unless the sender requests one card.

options.title: Automatic image cards
options.body: Automatically compose one card whenever Feishu sends include text or presentation plus image attachments, with sequential fallback on upload or card-send failure.

options.title: Wait for generic presentation images
options.body: Defer Feishu-specific behavior until the shared presentation contract grows a safe cross-channel image block.

recommendation.title: Opt-in image cards
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing sequential text-plus-media sends keep their current behavior unless the sender requests one card.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is the declared Feishu plugin owner in package metadata and was already pulled into the issue timeline for this Feishu-specific decision.
